description.value:
Trigger You are hit with an unarmed Strike or a Strike with a non-reach melee weapon

Frequency once per day

Effect You twist your body so that the attacker hits a hard edge of bone or armor, injuring themselves. You deal @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d8[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d8.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
